name: Yamaho Shujirou
source:
Founder and current chairman of YAMAHO Musical Instruments. He was ill and was admitted to a hospital in Kitakyushu City, but he has a muscular physique and does not look like a sick person.

Lieselotte Schreiber's grandfather
